messages.text:
**Calorimeter recommendation for MAG-03/04/06:** reclaim the inner-coil space while retaining tracker, forward calorimeter and main-coil allocations.

| Allocation | Proposed bounds |
|---|---|
| ECal barrel | r = 1.30–1.66 m |
| ECal endcap | outer r = 1.66 m; other bounds unchanged |
| HCal barrel | r = 1.76–4.20 m |
| HCal endcap | unchanged |

All calorimeter axial coordinates remain unchanged. This preserves:

- ECal thickness of 0.36 m;
- 0.06 m tracker-service/ECal clearance;
- 0.10 m ECal/HCal separation;
- existing forward apertures and |eta| = 5 geometric reach;
- outer magnet and stepped muon allocations.

The HCal barrel gains **0.40 m of host depth**, without assuming a material recipe or improved containment.

**Checks executed:** existing `ray_interval` calculation sampled 10,001 prompt rays over eta 0–3.5. Neither ECal nor HCal summed host path decreases relative to the baseline, within floating-point precision. No sampled zero-path hole appears. ECal barrel/endcap transition moves to higher eta, retaining overlapping geometric coverage. These are allocation checks, not shower or sensitive-coverage validation.

The system architect received the recommendation and numerical checks directly. Alternative tracker enlargement needs layer/lever-arm requirements; shifting the entire calorimeter inward leaves unexplained outer space or requires a new coil/field configuration. Retaining the outer boundary and assigning released width to HCal is the cleaner first prototype.

No files changed. DES-004 proposal remains unsigned; steel loading, actual interaction lengths, segmentation, services and shower performance require later validation.

limitations: Only userMessage and agentMessage text retained; reasoning, tool arguments/results and private state excluded.
